result.instructions: Tools for Sell.app, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our products had the most sales this month?"; "Show me the orders from the last page of results and their totals."; "Find the license key that customer@example.com bought and check its status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sell.app data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sellapp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sellapp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sellapp_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sellapp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sellapp_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the store's products, 15 per page. Filter by visibility, drafts or whether a product has sales. Sell.app API: GET /v2/products.

with_drafts.description: Include draft products as well as published ones.

has_sales.description: true for products with at least one completed sale.

visibility.description: Only products with one of these visibilities (e.g. HIDDEN).

tools.name: sellapp_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/products/{product}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List the store's orders, 15 per page. Results include customer and payment summaries without sensitive data. Sell.app API: GET /v2/orders.

tools.name: sellapp_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by its numeric ID, with totals in minor units, status timeline and line-item summaries. Sell.app API: GET /v2/orders/{order}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_disputes
tools.title: List disputes
tools.description: List the store's payment disputes (chargebacks), most recent first, 50 per page. Sell.app API: GET /v2/disputes.

tools.name: sellapp_list_license_keys
tools.title: List license keys
tools.description: List license keys issued by the store, 15 per page. Filter by key text, customer email, product or order. Sell.app API: GET /v2/license-keys.

key.description: Keep keys that contain this text (letters, digits, hyphens).

customer_email.description: Keep keys of the customer with exactly this email.

product_id.description: Keep keys issued for this product ID.

order_id.description: Keep keys issued by this order ID.

tools.name: sellapp_get_license_key
tools.title: Get a license key
tools.description: Get one license key by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/license-keys/{license_key}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List the store's coupon codes, 15 per page. Sell.app API: GET /v2/coupons.

tools.name: sellapp_get_coupon_usage
tools.title: Get coupon usage
tools.description: Get the usage record of one coupon by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/coupons/{coupon}/usage.

tools.name: sellapp_get_store_settings
tools.title: Get store settings
tools.description: Get the store configuration and status flags. Secret analytics credentials appear only as configured yes/no values. Sell.app API: GET /v2/store/settings.

tools.name: sellapp_get_permissions
tools.title: Get key permissions
tools.description: Show which abilities and store permissions the API key has for this store. Sell.app API: GET /v2/permissions.
